1. CLASS TRIP — Meet at the bus stop at ten. Bring your own guidebook and a packed lunch. The teacher will carry the group tickets.

2. BUS UPDATE — Heavy traffic has delayed the bus. Stay together at the stop; the driver will collect your group here.

3. BOAT NOTICE — The first boat has left. The next single journey starts at two. Please keep your ticket ready.

4. Hi Jo, the blue case is ours. Please leave it beside the teacher’s bag, not on the path. Sam

5. GUIDEBOOK DESK — If you borrow a book, return it before you leave. You may copy the directions into your notebook.

6. RETURN JOURNEY — The coach leaves at four. Please arrive ten minutes early so the group has time to find its seats.
